jobs.title: Campus Director (student leadership, part-time)
jobs.location: On campus (any university; remote support from ET team)
jobs.summary: Help fellow students make their theses better for them and for the world. Campus Directors run Effective Thesis's 8-week Accelerator (structured like an EA intro fellowship): light supported recruiting, then guiding a cohort through frameworks like ITN and Theory of Change to connect academic work to pressing global challenges. ET alumni have gone on to MIT, the Institute for Progress, the Tony Blair Institute, and Anthropic.
responsibilities: Run one cohort session per week plus light prep (about 4-6 hours/week over 8 weeks, mid-October to early December)
Light, supported on-campus recruiting for your cohort
Facilitate frameworks (ITN, Theory of Change) with training and materials provided by the ET team
requirements: No prior facilitation experience needed - training provided
jobs.notes: Applications are rolling - apply ASAP; interest is high. Includes a small stipend (US$125), 1:1 mentorship, public credit on the ET website, and a reference. Deadline shown here is an estimate tied to the mid-October program start; the true process is rolling.

jobs.title: AI Governance Researcher / Research Manager
jobs.location: Singapore (office-based; up to 3 months a year remote; work visa support available)
jobs.summary: Research and analysis on AI safety and governance in Singapore and Southeast Asia, including the State of AI Safety in Singapore reports, plus support for international convenings such as the International Scientific Exchange on AI Safety (ISE 2026).
responsibilities: Contribute to, and depending on experience lead, original research and writing on Singapore's AI safety and governance
Develop policy analysis and recommendations for Singapore, Southeast Asia and international developments
Support planning and delivery of international convenings, workshops and stakeholder engagements in Singapore
requirements: Undergraduate degree in public policy, international relations, political science, AI/technology governance or related
Strong research, analytical and English writing skills, and/or experience organising international convenings
Preferred - AI safety/governance or tech-policy experience; familiarity with Singapore's AI policy landscape; basic Mandarin reading and listening
jobs.notes: Applications close 12 October 2026, 23:59 SGT (rolling review may continue if unfilled). Hiring process - application form, written test, two interviews, two-day in-person work trial. Full job description: https://concordia-ai.com/career/ai-governance-researcher-research-manager-singapore/
